name: celestial_armor_creature_protected_even_if_the_armor_left
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control. That creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.' Support card: FDN Scorching Dragonfire (verified instant: 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker). The Armor enters and its trigger goes on the stack targeting seat 0's Bear (its one legal target); with the trigger waiting (held priority) the Armor is destroyed (moved to the graveyard by another effect). The trigger resolves: the attach does nothing (CR 701.3b), but the Bear, 'that creature', still gains hexproof and indestructible: seat 1's Scorching Dragonfire cannot target it, and 10 damage does not destroy it. The Bear stays 2/2, never equipped.
